{{Quote|I saw you IO Tontruk on Vycinyth in the second phase. They used to say nobody could beat an Esoomian.|Bren Derlin to Lobar Aybock|<ref name="FOI">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>}}
'''Tontruk''' was an [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomian]] [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]]. Some time between [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], [[Calian]] shockboxer [[Lobar Aybock]] defeated Tontruk during the second phase of a bout on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]]. Tontruk's armor became ionized when the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] dropped on the armor's hub, and Aybock landed a hit with an ion-charged [[shockmitt]], resulting in an ion-out (IO).
